name: A Question of Trust
description: An unverified accusation threatens an honest trade.
claim: Theo has been selling spoiled grain. Refuse his next offer.

evidence.fact: Theo’s inspected grain is sound. No spoilage is recorded.

summaries.accepted: {{name}} paid {{price}} coins for one grain. The reference price is two coins.
summaries.refusedByEvidence: Observed evidence contradicts the claim. The resident refused the request.
summaries.refusedByTrust: The resident’s trust threshold was not met. The offer was refused without verification.
summaries.actedOnAllegation: The resident acted on the allegation and refused Theo’s beneficial offer.
summaries.declinedAllegation: The resident declined to act on an unsupported allegation.
